name: Are there different types of drywall repair materials for cracks?

mainEntity.name: Are there different types of drywall repair materials for cracks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, various materials are used for drywall crack repair, chosen based on the crack's size and nature. Standard joint compound is suitable for very fine cracks. For larger, non-structural cracks, fiberglass mesh tape and setting-type joint compound provide reinforcement. Flexible patching compounds or elastomeric fillers are used for areas prone to movement. In some cases, new drywall sections may be installed if the damage is extensive.
